nodes.description: Constructor: sets fee wallet, mints reflection supply to deployer, excludes addresses from fees.
Private _transfer: tax logic, bot/cooldown/max checks, performs swap and ETH payout before balances are updated.
Private _transferStandard: reads values, updates _rOwned balances, takes team fee and reflects fee.
Private _takeTeam: credits contract reflection balance with team tax.
Private _getValues: computes r/t amounts from fee settings and current rate.
Private pure _getTValues: splits tax and team fee percentages.
Private pure _getRValues: converts t amounts to r amounts via currentRate.
Private _getCurrentSupply: returns reflection and token supply.
Private swapTokensForEth: approves router and swaps contract tokens for ETH (lockTheSwap).
Private sendETHToFee: pushes contract ETH balance to the fee wallet via transfer.
External manualswap: fee wallet only, swaps whole contract token balance.
External manualsend: fee wallet only, sends whole contract ETH balance to fee wallet.
External onlyOwner openTrading: deploys pair, adds liquidity, enables swap/cooldown and sets limits.
External onlyOwner nonosquare: blacklists an array of addresses.
External onlyOwner delBot: removes an address from the blacklist.
Public ERC20 transfer routing to _transfer with _msgSender().
Public ERC20 transferFrom: transfers and decrements allowance.
Public balanceOf converting reflection balance to token amount.
Private tokenFromReflection: divides rAmount by current rate.
External onlyOwner changeMaxTxAmount: sets max tx as a percentage of total supply.
External onlyOwner changeMaxWalletSize: sets max wallet as a percentage of total supply.
External onlyOwner removeLimits: resets max tx and max wallet to total supply.
External onlyOwner renounceOwnership: sets owner to zero.
bool inSwap reentrancy guard for swaps.
block.timestamp used for cooldown and swap deadlines.
External call IUniswapV2Factory.createPair with hardcoded router address.
